meaning: Verified means the local wage-tax jurisdiction/rate rules have evidence and a supported calculation for the modeled full-year resident employee. It does not certify a tax return, exact address, or every federal/state deduction. Missing coverage is never a verified zero.
limitations: The place index contains neighborhoods and unincorporated places as well as cities.
Municipal, school and transit boundaries may require residence and workplace addresses.
Single-county mappings use representative geography; cross-county cities can differ within the city.
Rules from older publications need confirmation if law changes; the checked date is a review date, not the source publication date.

wi-law.title: Wisconsin Statutes 66.0611
wi-law.summary: Wisconsin prohibits political subdivisions from taxing income or using income as a tax measure.

ca-law.title: California Office of Tax Appeals: R&TC 17041.5, footnote 20
ca-law.summary: California prohibits local personal income taxes. Business gross-receipts taxes are employer liabilities, outside this employee wage model.

az-law.title: Arizona Revised Statutes 43-201
az-law.summary: Income taxation is reserved to the state while urban revenue sharing under 43-206 remains in effect.

wa-law.title: Washington RCW 1.90.100
wa-law.summary: For 2026, state law prohibits local personal income taxes. Employer payroll-expense taxes do not reduce employee wages in this model.

fl-law.title: Florida Constitution, Article VII, sections 5 and 9
fl-law.summary: Personal income taxation is constitutionally prohibited; local taxing authority does not create an exception for employee wages.

nv-law.title: Nevada Constitution, Article 10, section 1(9)
nv-law.summary: The constitution prohibits taxes on natural persons’ wages and personal income.

la-law.title: Louisiana Constitution, Article VII, section 4(C)
la-law.summary: Political subdivisions may not impose income taxes.

tn-law.title: Tennessee Constitution, Article II, section 28
tn-law.summary: The 2014 constitutional amendment prohibits state and local taxes on payroll and earned personal income, subject to its pre-2011 exception.

ga-law.title: Georgia General Assembly: 2010 enactment of O.C.G.A. 48-7-140
ga-law.summary: Section 48-7-140 prohibits political subdivisions from collecting local income taxes.

nc-law.title: North Carolina General Statutes 105-247
nc-law.summary: The statute prohibits city, town, township and county taxes on income.

wy-law.title: Wyoming Statutes, Title 39: income-tax preemption
wy-law.summary: Wyoming reserves income and earnings taxation to the state and prohibits political subdivisions from imposing wage-based taxes.

mn-law.title: Minnesota House Research: Background Briefing on Minnesota Taxes, 2025
mn-law.summary: House Research confirms Minnesota has no local income taxes and that state law prohibits their imposition.

sc-commerce.title: South Carolina Department of Commerce: incentives and taxes
sc-commerce.summary: The state Department of Commerce confirms there is no local income tax.

il-handbook.title: Illinois General Assembly: Tax Handbook for Legislators, 2025
il-handbook.summary: The personal income tax chapter confirms no local income tax is authorized; the constitution requires statutory authorization even for home-rule units.

va-law.title: Code of Virginia 58.1-300
va-law.summary: Current law reserves income taxation to the state and prohibits counties, cities, towns and other political subdivisions from taxing income.

va-repeal.title: Code of Virginia: repeal of local income-tax authority
va-repeal.summary: Sections 58.1-540 through 58.1-549, which previously authorized some local income taxes, were repealed in 2013.

nj-payroll.title: Rutgers University Finance: 2025 W-2 guidance, issued for 2026 filing
nj-payroll.summary: The state university payroll office confirms New Jersey has no local wage-tax filing requirement; state disability and unemployment amounts in W-2 local boxes are not local income taxes.

nj-newark.title: Newark Finance: 2026 payroll-tax booklet
nj-newark.summary: The 2026 instructions make the employer responsible for the Newark payroll tax. It is not an employee wage tax.

nj-jersey-city.title: Jersey City Finance: payroll-tax FAQ
nj-jersey-city.summary: Jersey City expressly prohibits employers from deducting or withholding its payroll tax from employee wages.

ar-act.title: Arkansas Legislature: Act 96 of 2023
ar-act.summary: The legislature records enactment of HB1026 as Act 96, prohibiting local governments from imposing income taxes.

ar-text.title: Arkansas Legislature: HB1026 enacted as Act 96
ar-text.summary: The enacted text repeals municipal income-tax authority and prohibits counties, municipalities and other local governments from taxing income.

pa-lookup.title: Pennsylvania DCED: local income tax information
pa-lookup.summary: Residence and work addresses determine municipal and school district earned-income taxes and local-services tax.

oh-lookup.title: Ohio government: local tax information
oh-lookup.summary: The Finder resolves municipal and school-district income taxes using residence and workplace addresses.

ia-lookup.title: Iowa Department of Revenue: school district surtax and EMS tax
ia-lookup.summary: School-district surtax and EMS income tax depend on the resident jurisdiction and state income tax.

mi-list.title: Michigan Treasury: cities imposing an income tax
mi-list.summary: Treasury lists 24 taxing cities. A named place or postal city alone does not establish municipal tax boundaries.

or-local.title: Portland Revenue Division: personal income tax
or-local.summary: Metro SHS and Multnomah PFA taxes have separate jurisdiction boundaries, thresholds and rates.

or-eugene.title: Eugene: Community Safety Payroll Tax
or-eugene.summary: Eugene has an employee payroll tax in addition to employer payroll tax.

in-2026.title: Indiana DOR Departmental Notice 1, January 2026
in-2026.summary: County residence on January 1 determines local tax. The notice publishes all 92 rates and a $1,000 personal exemption.

md-2026.title: Maryland Comptroller: 2026 Withholding Tax Facts
md-2026.summary: Publishes actual 2026 county rates, including Allegany and Kent changes, Anne Arundel marginal brackets, and Frederick whole-income rate bands.

kc-tax.title: Kansas City: earnings tax
kc-tax.summary: Kansas City resident wages are subject to a 1% earnings tax.

stl-tax.title: St. Louis: Earnings Tax Department
stl-tax.summary: St. Louis resident wages are subject to a 1% earnings tax.

wilmington-tax.title: Wilmington: wage and net-profits taxes
wilmington-tax.summary: Wilmington resident wages are subject to a 1.25% earned-income tax.

denver-tax.title: Denver: occupational privilege tax FAQ
denver-tax.summary: Denver employee tax is $5.75 per qualifying month at $500 or more in monthly wages. Assumes level earnings across 12 months.

glendale-tax.title: Glendale: occupational privilege tax
glendale-tax.summary: Glendale employee tax is $5 per qualifying month above $750 in monthly wages. Assumes level earnings across 12 months.

greenwood-tax.title: Greenwood Village: occupational privilege tax
greenwood-tax.summary: Greenwood Village employee tax is $2 per qualifying month at $250 or more in monthly wages. Assumes level earnings across 12 months.

ny-local.title: New York: NYC, Yonkers and MCTMT
ny-local.summary: NYC resident income tax and Yonkers resident surcharge apply to the respective city residents. MCTMT is an employer or self-employment tax, not an employee wage deduction.

ny-rates.title: New York Tax Law 1304: city resident rates
ny-rates.summary: Current law retains the resident city marginal tax schedule through 2029.

ny-additional.title: New York Tax Law 1304-B: city additional tax
ny-additional.summary: The additional 14% city tax combines with section 1304 rates; the model includes the combined schedule.

ny-credits.title: New York Tax Department: city credits
ny-credits.summary: City household, earned-income and school credits are modeled where eligible. The income-tax elimination credit requires dependents, outside this no-children model.

yonkers-rate.title: New York Tax Department: IT-201 instructions, Yonkers worksheet
yonkers-rate.summary: The Yonkers resident surcharge is 16.75% of the specified state tax liability, after the listed credit adjustments.

yonkers-law.title: New York Tax Law 1321: Yonkers resident surcharge
yonkers-law.summary: Current law authorizes the Yonkers resident surcharge for tax years beginning before 2028.
